description: This file implements the native application glue for Android, managing activity lifecycle, input, window events, and configuration changes through callback functions and a dedicated thread.

classes.name: struct android_app
classes.description: Structure holding application state, including activity, input, window, configuration, synchronization primitives, and message handling.

methods.name: android_app_create
methods.description: Initializes the android_app structure, sets up communication pipes, and starts the application thread.

methods.name: android_app_free
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with android_app, signals destruction, and waits for thread termination.

methods.name: android_app_set_input
methods.description: Sets the input queue for the application, updating state and signaling the main thread.

methods.name: android_app_set_window
methods.description: Sets the native window, updating state and signaling the main thread.

methods.name: android_app_set_activity_state
methods.description: Updates the activity state and signals the main thread.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Callback invoked when activity is destroyed; cleans up application resources.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Callback invoked when activity starts; updates activity state.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Callback invoked when activity resumes; updates activity state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the activity for later restoration.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Callback invoked when activity pauses; updates activity state.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Callback invoked when activity stops; updates activity state.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes, updates configuration object, and logs current config.

methods.name: ANativeActivity_onCreate
methods.description: Entry point called when native activity is created; sets up all activity callbacks and initializes application state.
